item.title: Book - Hard things about Hard things
item.description:
Core Idea

Building and running a company is mostly about dealing with painful, uncertain, messy situations where there are no perfect answers.

The book repeatedly says: There are no shortcuts, formulas, or management hacks for the hardest problems.

A CEO’s real job is:

  1. Make difficult decisions

  2. Keep the company alive

  3. Create clarity amid chaos

  4. The Struggle

Ben Horowitz calls it “The Struggle”.

It is the phase where: • Everything is breaking • Employees lose confidence • Customers are unhappy • Cash is low • You doubt yourself
